name: Disable WP Robots
author: Jeff Starr

sections.description:
Does one thing: Disables the robots meta tag added by WordPress.

👉 Uses only 1KB of code, so super lightweight, fast, and effective.

Features

  • Lightweight – only one line of code
  • Simple to use – activate and done
  • No settings to worry about
  • Easy peasy.

More infos

For more information about the new WP Robots functionality:

  • New Robots API
  • WordPress Plugin: Disable WP Robots

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or store any user data. It does not set any cookies, and it does not connect to any third-party locations. Thus, this plugin does not affect user privacy in any way.

Disable WP Robots is developed and maintained by Jeff Starr, 15-year WordPress developer and book author.
sections.installation:
Installing the plugin

Activate like any other plugin and done. There are no settings, works automatically.

More info on installing WP plugins.

Uninstalling

To uninstall/remove the plugin, visit the Plugins screen, deactivate and delete the plugin. This plugin makes no changes to the WP database.
sections.faq:
Why is this useful?

Many sites add meta tags via SEO plugins, theme enhancements, custom code, or whatever. So when WordPress adds another set of meta tags, there may be conflicting or redundant tags, which is not optimal for SEO.

This simple plugin disables the WP robots meta tag completely, so they will not interfere with existing meta robots configurations.

Is there an “Undo” to reverse the disable?

Yes just deactivate the plugin. When the plugin is not active, WordPress will return to default behavior and include the meta robots tag in your pages.

Got a question?

Send any questions or feedback via my contact form
